release_decision: Retain the exact published GitHub grid and all its extracted diffusion resistances. Do not replace them with historical values, zeroed diagnostics, or fitted numbers to recover old timing.
model_boundary_scope: BSIM-CMG RDSMOD0 distinguishes internal bias-dependent extension resistance from geometry-dependent bias-independent diffusion resistance. Published card has RGEOMOD0 and zero RSHS/RSHD defaults. Process calibration provenance is insufficient to establish empirical correctness or a unique overlap boundary; document this, and do not assert that resistance magnitude alone proves double counting.
status: Source value difference and numerical causality established; physical silicon calibration not claimed.
